name: Coupons and Discounts for Woocommerce
author: Milkan Trninic

sections.description:
Coupons and Discounts for Woocommerce (Coupandi) helps you run promotions without touching your product prices one by one.

Store-Wide Sales
Run a global sale with a configurable discount percentage, start and end dates, a sale name and a custom label shown to customers. Prices, sale badges and discount labels update automatically — and revert automatically when the sale ends.

Category Sales
Apply different discount percentages to specific product categories, each with its own optional date range. Customers always get the best available discount: when a category discount is bigger than the global sale, the category discount wins.

Smart Coupon Handling
Decide what happens to coupons during a sale. Either block them completely, or allow only coupons that give a bigger discount than the running sale — so promotions never stack by accident. Applying a coupon also removes the Free Shipping method (unless the coupon itself allows free shipping), preventing double discounts.

New-User-Only Coupons
Restrict any WooCommerce coupon to logged-in customers with a custom rejection message — perfect for welcome discounts.

Bulk Price Adjustment
Increase or decrease all regular prices by a percentage, with a preview before applying, batched processing that won’t time out on large catalogs, and the option to skip selected products.

Coupandi Pro

Need more? Coupandi Pro adds:

  • Club and Merchant pricing tiers per user (B2B/wholesale)
  • Per-user percentage discounts and exact product prices
  • Private categories — hide categories and products from selected users
  • Newsletter campaigns — tokenized links with campaign pricing and analytics
  • Price analysis — compare revenue across pricing schemes
  • Bulk adjustment of club and merchant prices
  • Unlimited category sales
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  3. Go to Coupandi → Sale Configuration to set up your first sale.
  4. Optional: add category discounts under Coupandi → Category Sales (up to 3 in the free version).
  5. Optional: mark any coupon as “New User Only” on the coupon edit screen.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin change my product prices in the database?

Sales are applied dynamically — your stored prices are untouched and everything reverts when the sale ends. Only the Bulk Price Adjustment tool permanently changes stored prices, and it warns you and shows a preview before doing so.

Can customers combine coupons with the sale?

You choose: block all coupons during a sale, or allow only coupons that beat the sale discount. Discounts never stack.

What is the difference between the free and Pro version?

The free version covers store-wide and category sales, coupon rules and bulk regular-price adjustment. Pro adds per-user pricing tiers (Club/Merchant), private categories, newsletter campaign pricing with analytics, price analysis tools and unlimited category sales.
